Anyone on this Wi-Fi with the QR code, or with the short link and its code, can watch.

The picture and sound reach the browser encrypted (WebRTC). The link and the page are plain http, so anyone on this Wi-Fi who gets the link can open it, and a browser that can\'t use WebRTC gets an unencrypted stream. Share it only on a Wi-Fi you trust. Each start makes a new link.
The link writes the phone\'s Wi-Fi address as one number; the browser shows it the usual way once open.
